REGIONAL REGULATION OF EAST KUTAI REGENCY NUMBER 3 OF 2023

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF EAST KUTAI,

a. that every woman has the right to protection of her person, family, honor, dignity, and property under her control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from threats of fear to do or not do something that is a basic right;

b. that to provide a guideline or reference for the regional government and stakeholders related to improving the quality of life of women and protection of women, especially for women victims of violence;

c. that to provide direction, foundation and legal certainty to all parties involved in the empowerment of women and children, it is necessary to regulate the establishment of an Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children;

d. that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a through c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women;

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading: Article 1
text:
Pasal 1

Dalarn peraturan ini, yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Kutai Timur.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom Kabupaten Kutai Timur.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Kutai Timur.
4. Dinas adalah Dinas Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak Kabupaten Kutai Timur.
5. Desa adalah kesatuan masyarakat hukum yang memiliki batas wilayah yang berwenang untuk mengatur dan mengurus urusan pemerintahan, kepentingan masyarakat setempat berdasarkan prakarsa masyarakat, hak asal usul dan Zatau hak tradisional yang diakui dan dihormati dalam sistem pemerintahan Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia.
6. Keluarga adalah orang yang mempunyai hubungan darah dalarn garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah dan garis menyamping sarnpai derajat ketiga, atau yang mempunyai hubungan perkawinan, atau orang yang menjadi tanggungan perempuan.
7. Perlindungan . . .

BUPATIKUTAITIMUR

PROVINSIKALIMANTANTIMUR

7. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam pemenuhan hak haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten dan sistematis yang ditujukan untuk mencapai kesetaraan gender.

8. Pelayanan adalah segala upaya dan tindakan untuk memenuhi hak korban yang meliputi layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial, pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum.

9. Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan yang melanggar , menghambat, meniadakan kenikmatan, dan mengabaikan hak asasi perempuan.

10. Perempuan Korban Kekerasan adalah perempuan yang mengalami tindak kekerasan dan diskriminasi yang tidak terpenuhi hak-haknya.

11. Rehabilitasi Kesehatan adalah pemulihan Perempuan Korban kekerasan dari gangguan kesehatan yang dideritanya.

12. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah segala upaya untuk memulihkan dan mengembangkan kemampuan Perempuan Korban Kekerasan agar dapat menjalankan peran dan fungsi sosialnya baik dalam kehidupan keluarga dan/ atau masyarakat.

13. Pemulangan adalah upaya pengembalian Perempuan Korban Kekerasan kepada pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhannya.

14. Reintegrasi Sosial adalah upaya penyatuan kembali Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dengan pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhan bagi korban.

15. Bantuan ...

BUPATIKUTAITIMUR

15. Bantuan Hukum adalah jasa hukum yang diberikan oleh pen damping hukum dan advokat untuk melakukan proses pendampingan saksi dan/ atau Perempuan Korban Kekerasan.

16. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu yang selanjutnya disingkat PPT adalah suatu unit kerja fungsional yang menyelenggarakan pelayanan terpadu untuk Perempuan Korban Kekerasan.

17.Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UPTD PPA adalah unit pelayanan terpadu yang dibentuk oleh Pemerintah Daerah untuk memberikan Pelayanan kepada Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dan anak secara komprehensif meliputi pelayanan layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial , pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum.

18. Standar Pelayanan Minimal yang selanjutnya disingkat SPM adalah tolak ukur kinerja pelayanan UPTD PPA dalam memberikan pelayanan layanan pengaduan, rehabilitasi kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial, pemulangan, reintegrasi sosial, dan bantuan hukum bagi Perempuan Korban Kekerasan dan anak.

19. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara, yang diberikan untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap Perempuan Korban Kekerasan sesuai dengan standar yang telah ditentukan.
translated_text:
Article 1

In this regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is East Kutai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the regional government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region of East Kutai Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of East Kutai.
4. Office is the Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection of East Kutai Regency.
5. Village is a legal community unit that has territorial boundaries authorized to regulate and manage government affairs, the interests of the local community based on community initiative, rights of origin and/or traditional rights recognized and respected in the government system of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia.
6. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral lines up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of the woman.
7. Protection . . .

REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

7. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.

8. Service is all efforts and actions to fulfill the rights of victims including complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance.

9. Violence Against Women is any act that violates, hinders, eliminates enjoyment, and disregards the human rights of women.

10. Women Victims of Violence are women who experience acts of violence and discrimination whose rights are not fulfilled.

11. Health Rehabilitation is the recovery of Women Victims of Violence from health disorders they suffer.

12. Social Rehabilitation is all efforts to restore and develop the abilities of Women Victims of Violence so they can carry out their social roles and functions both in family life and/or society.

13. Repatriation is an effort to return Women Victims of Violence to their family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.

14. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite Women Victims of Violence with their family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

15. Legal Assistance ...

REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

15. Legal Assistance is legal services provided by legal companions and advocates to provide support to witnesses and/or Women Victims of Violence.

16. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a functional work unit that provides integrated services for Women Victims of Violence.

17.Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is an integrated service unit established by the Regional Government to provide Services to Women Victims of Violence and children comprehensively including complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance.

18. Minimum Service Standard hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for UPTD PPA services in providing complaint services, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance for Women Victims of Violence and children.

19. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection for Women Victims of Violence in accordance with established standards.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government has authority in the Protection of Women. (2) The authority as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. prevention of violence against women involving parties within the Regional scope;
h. provision of services for female victims of violence requiring Regional level coordination; and
c. strengthening and development of institutions providing women's protection services.

(2) Penyusunan dokumen perencanaan dan anggaran sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diselaraskan antar tingkatan dan susunan pemerintahan.

(3) Dinas memfasilitasi pengintegrasian kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan Perlindungan Perempuan ke dalam penyusunan dokumen perencanaan dan anggaran sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1).

translated_text:
Article 8

(1) The integration of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women in the Region is set forth in planning and budget documents which include:

a. Long-Term Regional Development Plan;
h. Medium-Term Regional Development Plan;
c. Strategic ...

REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

c. Strategic Plan of Regional Apparatus Work Units;

d. Regional Government Work Plan; and

e. Work Plan and Budget of Regional Apparatus Work Units.

(2) The preparation of planning and budget documents as referred to in paragraph (1) is harmonized between levels and structures of government.

(3) The Agency facilitates the integration of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women into the preparation of planning and budget documents as referred to in paragraph (1).

(4) In carrying out the facilitation as referred to in paragraph (3), the Agency coordinates with the Regional Development Planning Agency of East Kutai Regency.

MONITORING AND EVALUATION

Pasal 19

translated_text:
Article 19

(1) The Regional Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted to ascertain progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women in the Region.

(2) Hasil ...

(3) Evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 21

(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women is conducted at the end of each fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.

TENTANG

PERLINDUNGANPEREMPUAN

1. UMUM

Perlindungan terhadap perempuan penting dilakukan karena perempuan merupakan kelompok rentan atau tersubornasi, khususnya sehubungan dengan banyaknya kasus kekerasan terhadap perempuan yang menjadi korban.

Selanjutnya dalam Rencana Aksi Nasional Penghapusan Kekerasan terhadap perempuan Tahun 1999 dinyatakan bahwa perempuan sebagai ibu bangsa dan anak sebagai penerus bangsa merupakan mahkluk ciptaan Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, sehingga wajib dilindungi dan dijaga kehormatan, martabat dan harga dirinya secara wajar dan proporsional, baik secara hukum, ekonomi, politik, sosial dan budaya tanpa membedakan suku, agama, ras dan golongan.

Meskipun telah dilakukan upaya perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan juga adanya kebijakan pemerintah melalui peraturan perundang- undangan telah dengan tegas merumuskan upaya-upaya bagi perlindungan perempuan, termasuk upaya untuk melindungi perempuan korban kekerasan, namun dalam kenyataannya intensitas atau jumlah kekerasan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten Kutai Timur masih tinggi sedangkan pelayanan dan perlindungan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten Kutai Timur belum dilakukan secara optimal. Secara empiris di Kabupaten Kutai Timur, faktor penting yang berpengaruh dalam proses pencegahan dan perlindungan perempuan selama ini, karena dalam peraturan perundang- undangan yang ada, tidak diatur secara tegas tentang tata cara dan prosedur pencegahan dan perlindungan.

Serta ...

BUPATI KUTAI TIMUR

Serta dengan memperhatikan kondisi perkembangan pertumbuhan masyarakat beserta permasalahan hukumnya dan dengan dorongan dari berbagai regulasi yang memayungi tentang perlindungan perempuan khususnya terhadap perempuan korban kekerasan.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

1. GENERAL

Protection of women is important because women constitute a vulnerable or subordinated group, particularly in connection with the many cases of violence against women who become victims.

Furthermore, in the National Action Plan for the Elimination of Violence against Women of 1999, it is stated that women as mothers of the nation and children as successors of the nation are creations of Almighty God, and therefore must be protected and their honour, dignity and self-worth preserved in a reasonable and proportional manner, both legally, economically, politically, socially and culturally without distinction of ethnicity, religion, race and class.

Although efforts have been made to protect women and there are government policies through laws and regulations that have firmly formulated measures for the protection of women, including efforts to protect women victims of violence, in reality the intensity or number of cases of violence against women in East Kutai Regency is still high while services and protection for women in East Kutai Regency have not been optimally implemented. Empirically in East Kutai Regency, an important factor that has influenced the process of prevention and protection of women so far is that the existing laws and regulations do not explicitly regulate the procedures and mechanisms for prevention and protection.

As well ...

REGENT OF EAST KUTAI

EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

As well as taking into account the conditions of social development and growth along with its legal problems and with encouragement from various regulations governing the protection of women, particularly women victims of violence.

heading: Article 2

Pasal 2

Hurufa yang dimaksud dengan "penghormatan terhadap hak asasi manusia" adalah jaminan terpenuhinya hak dasar Hak Asasi Manusia.

Hurufb yang dimaksud dengan "kesetaraan gender" adalah kesamaan hak, kesempatan, manfaat dan pengambilan keputusan antara perempuan dan laki-laki termasuk dalam memasuki kesempatan ketja baik di sektor formal maupun informal.

Hurufc yang dimaksud dengan "non diskriminasi" adalah sikap dan perlakuan terhadap perempuan dengan tidak melakukan pembedaan atas dasar usia, jenis kelamin, ras, suku, agama dan antar golongan.

Hurufd yang dimaksud dengan "kepentingan yang terbaik perempuan" adalah semua tindakan terbaik yang menyangkut perempuan yang dilakukan oleh pemerintah daerah dan masyarakat, maka kepentingan yang terbaik bagi perempuan harus menjadi pertimbangan utama.
translated_text:
Article 2

Letter a what is meant by "respect for human rights" is the guarantee of the fulfilment of basic Human Rights.

Letter b what is meant by "gender equality" is equality of rights, opportunities, benefits and decision-making between women and men including in accessing employment opportunities both in the formal and informal sectors.

Letter c what is meant by "non-discrimination" is attitudes and treatment towards women without making distinctions on the basis of age, sex, race, ethnicity, religion and class.

Letter d what is meant by "the best interests of women" is all best actions concerning women carried out by the regional government and the community, so the best interests of women must be the primary consideration.
